answer: To thwart Sybil attacks, we formulate a subgame-perfect slashing matrix and dynamic opportunity-cost bonds, enforcing staking collateral and zero-knowledge verifiable delay to build a cryptoeconomic dune. This barrier proves expected attack utility from identity replication enters a strictly negative spiral, as rewards are eclipsed by slashing penalties, rendering multi-agent forgery irrational. The protocol thus converges to a robust Nash equilibrium where adversarial agents perform a synchronized sonnet of compliance, securing networks.
